basic_info.description: Located in the heart of San Francisco's Outer Sunset, this beautifully updated 4BR/2BA home blends classic charm with modern comfort across 1,705 sq ft of flexible living space. Freshly painted inside and out, the main level features refinished hardwood floors, high ceilings, and new recessed lighting. A sunlit living room flows into a spacious dining area, while the updated kitchen offers new cabinetry, countertops, and flooring. Two bedrooms on this level include a primary suite with a walk-in closet and shared access to a fully renovated bath with new vanity, tub, and tiled shower. The lower level adds versatility with two additional bedrooms, a second full bath, new flooring, and a family room with wet barideal for guests, extended family, or a home office. A 1-car garage, driveway parking, and low-maintenance backyard provide everyday convenience. Just blocks from Irving and Noriega Streets, enjoy access to local markets, shops, and eateries. Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, Sunset Reservoir Park, and Sunset Rec Center are all nearby. Easy access to 19th Ave, Sunset Blvd, and the MUNI N-Line makes commuting a breeze.
